name: Yashiro Kei
source:
The protagonist . He is a dull virgin who is neither good at studying nor athletics.

His parents are public school teachers, and his older brother EI is a police officer. He has a complex about Ei who is always perfect, but he thinks that an ordinary, normal life is the best.

He is estranged from his childhood friend Yua, whom he used to like.

[From [url=https://ubai.org/ubai/sfc/index.html#character]official site[/url]]
